sourceRefs.locator: Printed pp. 87–90, “Documents for Dating the Building”. Transcribes and locates signatures, describes the twelve-pointed star and rail on the east face of the minbar, gives AH 638 and compares opinions on the 22-line mosque charter and the loss of the hospital deed.
Inscriptions, individual entries for the north and west mosque portals, mihrab dome, west hospital portal, mosque minbar balustrade and central star. Includes Arabic terms and English renderings.

Description, passages on the north and west portals, pseudo-kündekari and openwork of the wooden minbar, and the three-iwan hospital with partial upper floor. How Monument was dated, two AH 626 inscriptions.
